themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: HSBC cut NVDA to Hold and its target to $170 from $365 on Nov 13, one of about ten Hold type downgrades since the CEO left (CNBC; Yahoo Finance). NVDA fell 2.01% Friday to 162.85 and 12.75% for the week (Massive). The money that moved to rivals came back out: AMD fell 8.75% to 534.06 Friday after a 30% run, and Cisco fell 6.24% to 95.64 as a 250 basis point gross margin squeeze overshadowed record revenue (Massive; Benzinga). For the week SMH still rose 4.91%. Separately, Bloomberg reported Nov 12 that Samsung is in talks to buy Modine, which makes data center chillers and liquid cooling; neither company confirmed and no price was reported. MOD rose 27.86% to 135.66 on Nov 13 on 8.43 million shares, about 4.5 times normal (Massive; Bloomberg; dashboard).
themes.for_you: No action before Nvidia reports Nov 17 after the close. AMD sits in its buy zone (525.17 to 571.19, Nov 13 build) but fell 8.75% in a day: wait for the report before any first tranche or put. MOD is not a setup; a 28% jump on an unconfirmed deal report is a bet on the deal, so do not chase it.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: Starship Flight 15 launched from Starbase at 5:48pm CST (6:48pm ET) on Nov 13 and reached orbit, but SpaceX waved off the booster tower catch and sent Super Heavy to a splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico. The ship is on a 22 hour flight and SpaceX may still try to catch it on Nov 14 (Space.com; Spaceflight Now). SPCX closed 139.11 on Nov 13 before the launch, up 3.60% for the week (Massive).
themes.for_you: No action. SPCX and RKLB are not setups. A ship catch would be a real step for launch costs, but the booster catch, the part that was waved off, matters as much. Watch Monday's open on volume.

innovations.name: Financials
innovations.what: Daily rotation recheck. The DTCC Tokenization Service went live Oct 28, 2026, the milestone this file was waiting on, and DTCC said Nov 12 it will add Solana (DTCC). Stablecoin supply fell to about $290.2B on Nov 8, down 4.6% in 30 days (DefiLlama via a tracker post), while Goldman, Citi and other banks committed about $270M to the Project Faro issuer for 2027 (Bloomberg, Nov 10). Pagaya's Q3 network volume rose 29% to $3.6B and it set 2026 volume at $12.725B to $13.025B (company). FedNow Q3 volume rose nearly 30% over Q2 (FedNow). No stage change: tokenized assets were already rated early adoption, and launch is not volume yet. Week to Nov 13 (Massive): SECZ +16.09% to 8.08, CRCL -8.37% to 62.20, COIN -5.28%, UPST -10.64%, PGY -3.60%, V +0.74%, MA +1.30%.
innovations.for_you: No action. None of these names is a swing setup or on the buy list. Falling stablecoin supply hurts CRCL and COIN, whose income tracks float times short rates; the DTCC launch helps the plumbing owners first. PYPL, on the buy list, is not moved by this.

innovations.name: Space
innovations.what: Starship Flight 15 lifted off at 5:48pm CST (6:48pm ET) Nov 13 and reached orbit on its 22 hour test; the planned booster catch was aborted and the booster splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico, and a ship catch may still be tried Nov 14 (Space.com; Spaceflight Now). No stage change: neither stage has been caught on this flight yet.
innovations.for_you: No action. Neither name is a setup. Move this innovation only after a full catch and reflight of the same hardware.

countries.name: China
countries.what: The White House said Nov 13 that Trump will meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin together on Nov 19 at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, which runs Nov 18 to 19 (Bloomberg; BBC). Shenzhen is 13 hours ahead of Eastern time, so the meeting falls on the night of Nov 18 to the early hours of Nov 19 ET; no exact time was given. China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban to the US still ends Nov 27 with no extension found (InvestorNews; mlq.ai). BABA fell 13.77% for the week to 94.38 (Massive).
countries.for_you: No action. No Chinese ADR is on the buy list. A deal on chips or metals in Shenzhen could move NVDA and MP after Nvidia's Nov 17 report, so avoid new puts in China exposed names until it is done.
